integrity: The proof is self-contained; integer tests are corroborative and not a replacement for infinite-size arguments. No independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The statement is restricted to finite rook graphs; no injective edge-coloring partition theorem or arbitrary product result. Equivalence with unindexed star-packing enumerations remains possible.
title: Edge-open-packing polynomial of rook graphs via three local blocks
